162: /**
163:  * Resolve deck keys through the practice cores first, then Atlas's prefix shards.
164:  * The complete index is deliberately reserved for a missing/broken shard manifest
165:  * or a shard lookup that cannot find an exact key: it is a compatibility fallback,
166:  * not the normal custom-deck transport.
167:  */
168: async function resolveDeckKeyMetadata(
169:   lemmaKeys: readonly string[],
170:   lexemes: readonly PracticeLexeme[],
171:   cache: Map<string, Promise<unknown>>,
172: ): Promise<Map<string, DeckKeyResolution>> {
173:   const practiceByKey = practiceLexemesByKey(lexemes);
174:   const resolutions = new Map<string, DeckKeyResolution>();
175:   const unresolved: string[] = [];
176: 
177:   for (const key of lemmaKeys) {
178:     const practice = keyLookupVariants(key)
179:       .map((variant) => practiceByKey.get(variant))
180:       .find((entry): entry is PracticeLexeme => Boolean(entry)) ?? null;
181:     resolutions.set(key, { practice, atlas: null });
182:     if (!practice) unresolved.push(key);
183:   }
184: 
185:   // The common case is a deck entirely covered by the practice cores. Do not
186:   // download any Atlas index artifact in that case.
187:   if (unresolved.length === 0) return resolutions;
188: 
189:   let rows: SearchRow[] = [];
190:   let needsFullIndexFallback = false;
191:   try {
192:     const manifest = await getShardJson<SearchShardManifest>('/lexicon/search-shards.json', cache);
193:     const shardPaths = Array.from(
194:       new Set(
195:         unresolved.flatMap((key) =>
196:           keyLookupVariants(key)
197:             .map((variant) => searchShardForQuery(manifest, variant)?.path)
198:             .filter((path): path is string => Boolean(path)),
199:         ),
200:       ),
201:     );
202:     if (shardPaths.length === 0) {
203:       needsFullIndexFallback = true;
204:     } else {
205:       rows = (await Promise.all(
206:         shardPaths.map((path) => getShardJson<SearchRow[]>(path, cache)),
207:       )).flat();
208:       const shardRowsByKey = searchRowsByKey(rows);
209:       needsFullIndexFallback = unresolved.some(
210:         (key) => !keyLookupVariants(key).some((variant) => shardRowsByKey.has(variant)),
211:       );
212:     }
213:   } catch {
214:     needsFullIndexFallback = true;
215:   }
216: 
217:   if (needsFullIndexFallback) {
218:     // Last resort only: older/static deployments can lack a manifest or a
219:     // relevant shard even though their legacy complete index still has the row.
220:     rows = await getShardJson<SearchRow[]>('/lexicon/search-index.json', cache).catch(() => []);
221:   }
222: 
223:   const atlasByKey = searchRowsByKey(rows);
224:   for (const key of unresolved) {
225:     const atlasRow = keyLookupVariants(key)
226:       .map((variant) => atlasByKey.get(variant))
227:       .find((entry): entry is SearchRow => Boolean(entry));
228:     if (!atlasRow) continue;
229:     const gloss = atlasRow.g ? cleanGloss(atlasRow.g) : '';
230:     resolutions.set(key, {
231:       practice: null,
232:       atlas: {
233:         lemma: atlasRow.l,
234:         slug: atlasRow.s,
235:         // Search-index text can be a dictionary definition. Only retain the
236:         // same concise first-sense labels eligible for practice cards.
237:         gloss: isPhraseGloss(gloss) ? null : gloss,
238:         cefr: atlasRow.c ?? null,
239:       },
240:     });
241:   }
242:   return resolutions;
243: }

245: function ensureDeckCustomSetCoverage(
246:   deck: PracticeDeckData,
247:   lemmaKeys: string[],
248:   resolutions: ReadonlyMap<string, DeckKeyResolution>,
249: ): PracticeDeckData {
250:   if (!deck || !lemmaKeys || lemmaKeys.length === 0) return deck;
251:   const existingIndexLemmas = new Set<string>();
252:   for (const item of deck.index ?? []) {
253:     existingIndexLemmas.add(item.lemmaId.toLocaleLowerCase());
254:     existingIndexLemmas.add(item.lemma.toLocaleLowerCase());
255:   }
256:   const newIndexItems: PracticeIndexItem[] = [];
257:   const newLexemes: PracticeLexeme[] = [];
258: 
259:   const clozeByLemma = new Map<string, string[]>();
260:   for (const c of deck.cloze ?? []) {
261:     const key1 = (c.lemmaId || '').toLowerCase();
262:     const key2 = (c.lemma || '').toLowerCase();
263:     if (key1) {
264:       if (!clozeByLemma.has(key1)) clozeByLemma.set(key1, []);
265:       clozeByLemma.get(key1)!.push(c.clozeId);
266:     }
267:     if (key2 && key2 !== key1) {
268:       if (!clozeByLemma.has(key2)) clozeByLemma.set(key2, []);
269:       clozeByLemma.get(key2)!.push(c.clozeId);
270:     }
271:   }
272: 
273:   let indexModified = false;
274:   const updatedIndex = (deck.index ?? []).map((item) => {
275:     const keyLower = item.lemmaId.toLowerCase();
276:     const customClozeIds = clozeByLemma.get(keyLower) ?? [];
277:     if (customClozeIds.length === 0) return item;
278: 
279:     const mergedClozeIds = Array.from(new Set([...(item.clozeIds ?? []), ...customClozeIds]));
280:     const hasCloze = mergedClozeIds.length > 0;
281:     const modesSet = new Set(item.modes ?? []);
282:     modesSet.add('flashcards');
283:     if (hasCloze) modesSet.add('cloze');
284: 
285:     const nextModes = Array.from(modesSet) as PracticeIndexItem['modes'];
286:     const modesChanged = nextModes.length !== (item.modes ?? []).length;
287:     const clozeIdsChanged = mergedClozeIds.length !== (item.clozeIds ?? []).length;
288:     const hasClozeChanged = hasCloze !== item.hasCloze;
289: 
290:     if (modesChanged || clozeIdsChanged || hasClozeChanged) {
291:       indexModified = true;
292:       return {
293:         ...item,
294:         clozeIds: mergedClozeIds,
295:         hasCloze,
296:         modes: nextModes,
297:       };
298:     }
299:     return item;
300:   });
301: 
302:   let orderCounter = (deck.index ?? []).length + 1;
303:   for (const key of lemmaKeys) {
304:     const keyLower = key.toLowerCase();
305:     if (!existingIndexLemmas.has(keyLower)) {
306:       existingIndexLemmas.add(keyLower);
307:       const cleanKey = cleanDeckKey(key);
308:       const atlas = resolutions.get(key)?.atlas ?? null;
309:       const matchedClozeIds = clozeByLemma.get(keyLower) ?? [];
310:       const hasCloze = matchedClozeIds.length > 0;
311: 
312:       // Learner-layout P0-3 / Opus P0-2: an unmatched custom-deck key has no resolved
313:       // practice-core content — claiming the full mode list here promised exercises
314:       // (e.g. a "5" on the Heritage card) that the active session then couldn't
315:       // deliver, landing the learner in an instant empty-mode dead end. Only claim
316:       // the modes this key actually resolves content for; other modes appear once
317:       // real shard data resolves them (same honesty rule as the built shards).
318:       newIndexItems.push({
319:         lemmaId: atlas?.slug ?? key,
320:         lemma: atlas?.lemma ?? cleanKey,
321:         cefr: atlas?.cefr ?? null,
322:         modes: hasCloze ? ['flashcards', 'cloze'] : ['flashcards'],
323:         hasCloze,
324:         clozeIds: matchedClozeIds,
325:         newOrder: orderCounter++,
326:       });
327: 
328:       newLexemes.push({
329:         lemmaId: atlas?.slug ?? key,
330:         lemma: atlas?.lemma ?? cleanKey,
331:         lemmaPlain: atlas?.lemma ?? cleanKey,
332:         ipa: null,
333:         gloss: atlas?.gloss ?? cleanKey,
334:         pos: null,
335:         cefr: atlas?.cefr ?? null,
336:         heritage: null,
337:         severity: null,
338:         paradigm: { cases: {} },
339:       });
340:     }
341:   }
342: 
343:   if (newIndexItems.length === 0 && !indexModified) return deck;
344: 
345:   return {
346:     ...deck,
347:     index: [...updatedIndex, ...newIndexItems],
348:     lexemes: [...(deck.lexemes ?? []), ...newLexemes],
349:   };
350: }

454: function translateGrammarTerm(ukLabel: string): string {
455:   if (!ukLabel) return '';
456:   const norm = ukLabel.toLowerCase().trim();
457:   const parts = norm.split(/[\s,]+/);
458:   if (norm.includes('відмінок')) {
459:     const caseName = parts.find(p => p !== 'відмінок' && p !== 'і' && CASE_GLOSSES[p]);
460:     const caseEn = caseName ? CASE_GLOSSES[caseName] : '';
461:     const otherParts = parts.filter(p => p !== 'відмінок' && p !== caseName).map(p => CASE_GLOSSES[p] || p);
462:     if (caseEn) {
463:       const caseStr = `${caseEn} case`;
464:       return otherParts.length > 0 ? `${caseStr}, ${otherParts.join(', ')}` : caseStr;
465:     }
466:   }
467: 
468:   if (norm.includes('рід')) {
469:     const genderName = parts.find(p => p !== 'рід' && CASE_GLOSSES[p]);
470:     const genderEn = genderName ? CASE_GLOSSES[genderName] : '';
471:     const otherParts = parts.filter(p => p !== 'рід' && p !== genderName).map(p => CASE_GLOSSES[p] || p);
472:     if (genderEn) {
473:       const genderStr = `${genderEn} gender`;
474:       return otherParts.length > 0 ? `${genderStr}, ${otherParts.join(', ')}` : genderStr;
475:     }
476:   }
477: 
478:   const translatedParts = parts.map(part => {
479:     if (CASE_GLOSSES[part]) return CASE_GLOSSES[part];
480:     for (const [uk, en] of Object.entries(CASE_GLOSSES)) {
481:       if (part.includes(uk)) return en;
482:     }
483:     return part;
484:   });
485: 
486:   return translatedParts.join(', ');
487: }

794: function isPhraseGloss(label: string): boolean {
795:   const clean = label.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
796:   // Count alphanumeric tokens (ignoring standalone punctuation) to match the
797:   // Python deck generator's `_meaning_label_word_count` regex exactly, so the
798:   // served deck and this runtime guard never disagree on eligibility.
799:   const wordCount = clean ? (clean.match(/[^\W_]+(?:[-'][^\W_]+)?/gu) || []).length : 0;
800:   return (
801:     !clean ||
802:     clean.length > MEANING_MC_MAX_CHARS ||
803:     wordCount > MEANING_MC_MAX_WORDS ||
804:     clean.includes('?') ||
805:     clean.includes('(') ||
806:     clean.includes(')')

810: export function isMeaningMcEligible(entry: PracticeLexeme): boolean {

814:   // "dog; hound" has a perfectly concise glossClean ("dog") and must stay eligible.
815:   if (!isEnglishLearnerGloss(label)) return false;
816:   if (isPhraseGloss(label)) return false;
817:   if (FUNCTION_GLOSS_HEADWORDS.has(glossHeadword(entry))) return false;
818:   if (entry.pos && FUNCTION_POS.has(entry.pos.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'))) return false;
819:   return entry.meaningMcEligible ?? true;

1091: export function meaningDistractors(
1092:   answer: PracticeLexeme,
1093:   deck: PracticeDeckData,
1094:   limit: number,
1095: ): PracticeLexeme[] {
1096:   const answerHeadword = glossHeadword(answer);
1097:   const answerLength = glossLabel(answer).length;
1098:   const answerRank = cefrRank(answer.cefr);
1099:   const candidatePool = deck.lexemes.filter(
1100:     (candidate) =>
1101:       candidate.lemmaId !== answer.lemmaId &&
1102:       isMeaningMcEligible(candidate) &&
1103:       glossHeadword(candidate) !== answerHeadword,
1104:   );
1105: 
1106:   // Build concentric CEFR rings around the answer. Distractors stay
1107:   // semantically comparable because we exhaust the closest ring before
1108:   // moving outward; this prevents a B1 answer from being undermined by A1
1109:   // distractors or an A1 answer from being ambushed by C1 vocabulary.
1110:   const rings = new Map<number, PracticeLexeme[]>();
1111:   for (const candidate of candidatePool) {
1112:     const gap = Math.abs(cefrRank(candidate.cefr) - answerRank);
1113:     const bucket = rings.get(gap) ?? [];
1114:     bucket.push(candidate);
1115:     rings.set(gap, bucket);
1116:   }
1117:   const sortedGaps = [...rings.keys()].sort((left, right) => left - right);
1118: 
1119:   const seenLabels = new Set<string>();
1120:   const result: PracticeLexeme[] = [];
1121:   for (const gap of sortedGaps) {
1122:     const ring = rings.get(gap) ?? [];
1123:     const picked = ring
1124:       .sort((left, right) => {
1125:         const leftPos = left.pos === answer.pos ? 0 : 1;
1126:         const rightPos = right.pos === answer.pos ? 0 : 1;
1127:         if (leftPos !== rightPos) return leftPos - rightPos;
1128:         const leftLen = Math.abs(glossLabel(left).length - answerLength);
1129:         const rightLen = Math.abs(glossLabel(right).length - answerLength);
1130:         return leftLen - rightLen || left.lemmaId.localeCompare(right.lemmaId);
1131:       })
1132:       .filter((entry) => {
1133:         const key = glossLabel(entry).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US');
1134:         if (seenLabels.has(key)) return false;
1135:         seenLabels.add(key);
1136:         return true;
1137:       });
1138:     result.push(...picked);
1139:     if (result.length >= limit) break;
1140:   }
1141:   return result.slice(0, limit);
1142: }

1144: function matchingPairs(selection: PracticeSelection, deck: PracticeDeckData, learnerLevel: CefrLevel) {
1145:   if (!isMeaningMcEligible(selection.lemma)) return [];
1146:   const distractors = meaningDistractors(selection.lemma, deck, 5);
